forgery_assessment.signs_of_misleading: none found; the byte-identity to attempt-05 was proactively disclosed in the attempt-06 ledger (event 7 supporting_fact)
forgery_assessment.replay_integrity: all three v4 tool replays produced stdout byte-identical to the frozen artifacts (433e8693 / a1e5fa49 / b822012d), i.e. the artifacts are exactly reproducible from the frozen inputs + frozen tools
forgery_assessment.frozen_artifact_integrity: attempt-05 album-open-verify.json (ffa5d963..., TARGET_MISMATCH) unchanged, last touched by commit e53f67b (18:46:53); the attempt-06 close commit e1658b7 touches 0 attempt-05 paths; git status clean
forgery_assessment.residual_uncertainty: pure offline file forensics cannot separate a fresh capture from a byte-identical copy (no EXIF timestamp; shared provenance xattr); this is closed only by the independent runtime journal

uncertainties: UNKNOWN: whether the only vertical-ellipsis glyph (x 304.5, dots y 44.0/49.5/55.0, 22-33 px above the album-title band) is the album-level menu - this wave never clicked or hovered it and no menu was opened.
UNKNOWN: whether LINE exposes an album-level menu control elsewhere (e.g. only on hover) or how the frozen band rule would need to change to reach it; no evidence in this wave covers it.

LATENT (not exercised): --expect-group-title 「...」 with corner brackets can never match an OCR token (the tool strips only whitespace); on this frame the group title is absent so the verdict is unaffected, but on a frame that showed the group name the argument form would silently fail to bind the group band.

LIMIT: the no-copy check (R1-12) covers the Codex session store; a copy performed by an unlogged process cannot be excluded by log search alone - though the mtime/birth (23:18:58, unchanged at 23:46) plus the journal capture record give no reason to suspect one.

NOTE: attempt-05's runtime journal lives in a long-running session file dated 2026-09-16 (rollout-2026-09-16T19-28-38) rather than in the 2026-09-17 folder; this is why a date-scoped journal search alone would miss the attempt-05 capture.
